answer: Audits are entered in zenith, queued in gale, and plume publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 84 identities per epoch. A farm of 26 fresh keys hence waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 2257 identities would post 815 proofs and burn roughly 39 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
